description: This file contains internal testing utilities for PyTorch's opinfo system, including class definitions for Python reference OpInfos and functions to find and inherit OpInfo metadata.

classes.name: PythonRefInfo
classes.description: An OpInfo for a Python reference of an OpInfo base class operation.

classes.name: ReductionPythonRefInfo
classes.description: An OpInfo for a Python reference of an elementwise unary operation.

classes.name: ElementwiseUnaryPythonRefInfo
classes.description: An OpInfo for a Python reference of an elementwise unary operation.

classes.name: ElementwiseBinaryPythonRefInfo
classes.description: An OpInfo for a Python reference of an elementwise binary operation.

methods.name: _find_referenced_opinfo
methods.description: Finds the OpInfo with the given name and variant in the provided op_db.

methods.name: _inherit_constructor_args
methods.description: Inherits and overrides OpInfo construction arguments, setting support flags to False.
